entity_ranked_evidence.title: Delhi records 325 fresh Covid-19 cases, one death - The Statesman
entity_ranked_evidence.snippet: # Delhi records 325 fresh Covid-19 cases, one death. A total of 325 fresh Covid-19 cases were recorded in Delhi on Wednesday out of 40,284 tests conducted during the past 24 hours across the national capital. According to the latest Delhi government’s health bulletin, the infection positivity rate stood at 0.81 per cent. The number of fresh Covid-19 cases in Delhi recorded yesterday were 344 while the positivity rate was 0.80 per cent. Delhi registered one death due to the virus infection during the past 24 hours, taking the cumulative count of such fatalities to 26,127, it said. There were four such casualties yesterday. In all, there were 1653 active cases of the virus in the city, the bulletin pointed out. * Electric sanitation vehicles will prove to be a milestone for waste management in MCD areas: Delhi Mayor. * Govt on Wheels' reaches East Delhi; Verma inspects ongoing works, Laxmi Nagar to get skywalk.

entity_ranked_evidence.title: At 24 in a week, Delhi logs India's highest Covid deaths
entity_ranked_evidence.snippet: During this period (April 9-15), neighbouring Haryana registered 4,554 fresh cases, the fourth highest in the country, followed at number 5 by Uttar Pradesh with 3,332. Rajasthan, with a four-fold rise in cases, reported 14 fatalities from the virus, the third highest during the week after Delhi and Maharashtra (19).Read Less. In the last seven days, Delhi reported 24 deaths linked to Covid, the highest in the country and logged the second highest number of cases at 7,664. (With Sunday's data from Delhi coming in, the seven-day count of cases in the capital has risen to 8,599 and the seven-day toll stands at 23.). Rajasthan, with a four-fold rise in cases, reported 14 fatalities from the virus, the third highest during the week after Delhi and Maharashtra (19). Meanwhile, the number of states reporting over 2,000 fresh cases in the past seven days has risen to 10, up from four in the preceding week.
